mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_registration (patient_id, work_plan_id, doctor_schedule_id, doctor_id, dept_sub_id, date, slot, status, payment_status) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{workPlanId}, #{doctorScheduleId}, #{doctorId}, #{deptSubId}, STR_TO_DATE(#{date}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{slot}, #{status}, #{paymentStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT maximum, num FROM doctor_work_plan_schedule WHERE id = #{doctorScheduleId} LIMIT 1

SELECT dws.maximum, dws.num, CASE WHEN dwp.status = 1 THEN 'SUSPENDED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS workPlanStatus FROM doctor_work_plan_schedule dws LEFT JOIN doctor_work_plan dwp ON dws.work_plan_id = dwp.id WHERE dws.id = #{doctorScheduleId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, doctor_schedule_id AS doctorScheduleId, status FROM medical_registration WHERE id = #{registrationId} LIMIT 1
